sources.citation: Araújo, Paulo Jeferson Pilar & Analú Fernandes de Oliveira. 2021. Línguas de sinais emergentes no Brasil: o caso da Língua de Sinais Macuxi. Revista de Letras Norte@mentos 14(37): 224-240. DOI 10.30681/rln.v14i37.7756.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic overview of an emerging family sign language (c. 10 deaf Macuxi siblings in Uiramutã); the only structural remarks (pp. 232-233) are a few sign minimal pairs distinguished by location or movement (PROFESSOR/ALUNO, FARINHA/CAXIRI) and a geocentric sign AMANHÃ. No phonology/prosody/prominence discussion; word stress in the spoken-language sense is not applicable to this visual-gestural language.
